displayAddress: Apartment , Horizon House, Borough Road, Sunderland
description:
A stylish and well-presented studio apartment situated within the popular Horizon House development in the heart of Sunderland city centre. This self-contained studio offers modern and comfortable living accommodation, comprising an open-plan lounge/bedroom area and a contemporary shower room. Residents benefit from access to a range of excellent communal facilities, including a gym, cinema room, games room, kitchen area, and laundry facilities. Ideally located within walking distance of Sunderland University, shops, restaurants, and transport links, this property is perfectly suited to first-time buyers, young professionals, or investors seeking a strong investment opportunity, with the potential to achieve a gross yield of approximately 12%.

Council Tax Band: A (Sunderland Council)
Tenure: Leasehold (245 years)
Ground Rent: £150 per year
Service Charge: £2,264.71 per year
